## D — Driver-license test preparation

Accuracy scope: every fact in Driver-license test preparation uses one physical page of the registered Kansas handbook, with original wording and one complete claim per block.
All quantities and exceptions are edition-bound. The cited handbook is the evidence; no recollection or competitor text supplies authority.
Source flags: Official sample questions remain private source material, with no stems or distractors reproduced. Image-only pages and maneuver diagrams do not establish geometry. Tire, underhood-inspection and road-test lane instructions have qualifications or inconsistencies requiring debt. Current booking availability is not verified. [A94] [A95] [A96] [A97] [A98] [A99] [A100] [A101] [A102] [A103] [A104] [A105] [A106] [A107]
Refresh disposition: legal thresholds and administrative procedures require rechecking against an issuer source when a later edition replaces this snapshot.

corpus_stability.reason: The bound Kansas handbook has one February 2022 revision label; the selected source contains no evidence of multiple annual corpus rewrites. Later legal or administrative changes require issuer rechecking.

verification_debt.claim_text: Page94 L15-24 lists full-service centers, approved driver education and ks.knowtodrive.com as knowledge-exam routes and links the issuer's station finder. Current availability, online eligibility and center services are not rechecked in this source-bound pass; do not claim a live booking option or additional eligibility conditions.

Page96 L31-41 says any part of Lincoln's head covered by tread means a safe amount. The text does not specify the legal numeric minimum or wet-road safety assumptions. Preserve the monthly/before-trip check recommendation, but do not teach the penny result as a universal safety guarantee or invent a tread measurement.

Page96 L24-29 directs comparing gauge pressure with the owner's manual or door-jamb value and adding/releasing air, but does not specify tire temperature. The value-location and gauge checks are retained; an unconditional release/add procedure remains debt.

Page96 L4-6 says the pre-trip test does not require opening the hood or going underneath, while page97 L11-20 gives underhood oil/coolant checks within the inspection discussion. Whether those fluid checks are test demonstrations or maintenance preparation is not explicit; no new test requirement is inferred.

Page99 has no extracted body text. Pages101-103 refer to maneuver diagrams and page103 supplies captions only; line/cone layout and vehicle geometry are not established without inspecting registered visuals. Page100 refers to Figures10.1-10.5 while subsequent captions use11.1-11.5; preserve the reference mismatch.

Page98 L17-19 suggests replacing a bulb or fuse after a failed brake-light check. A failed lamp does not establish which component failed across vehicle designs; testing and professional assistance are retained without a universal component diagnosis.

Page105 L20-25 describes expressway entry without stopping; L35-40 describes limited-access entry without stopping unless necessary. Preserve the latter exception and do not teach a universal prohibition against a safety-required stop.

Page106 L22-27 gives leftmost/rightmost turn finishes and rightmost travel unless blocked; earlier pages46-47 allow marked multiple turning lanes and a center travel lane on some roads. Road-test instructions cannot be converted into an exceptionless lane rule; proper-lane and no-intersection-lane-change instructions remain supported.

Page106 L14-16 generically says to stop at traffic signs or signals without naming which demand a stop. Do not teach stopping at every sign; the explicit stop-sign and stop-signal positioning instructions in L39-43 are retained.
